title: Premium Multi-Density Cheek Pads
features: Multi-density foam construction for superior comfort and impact absorption
Universal fit compatible with most full-face motorcycle helmets
Easy snap-in replacement design for quick installation
description:
Engineered to seamlessly integrate into modern helmet speaker cavities, the Premium Multi-Density Cheek Pads from Universal Moto provides riders with uninterrupted acoustic clarity and group connectivity. Built with IP67 Certified Dustproof & Submersion Resistant (All-Season Waterproof Seal), it boasts an installation rating of 2.5 / 10 (Clamp-mount or 3M VHB base with recessed speaker cavity routing).

The Premium Multi-Density Cheek Pads represents an indispensable touring and group-ride upgrade from Universal Moto. Its robust audio tuning and rock-solid weather sealing provide riders with effortless navigation cues and reliable connectivity across arduous highway tours.
